source_refs.note: Chapter 7 Student Learning Outcomes and Introduction as printed (PDF 93, printed 89).

blocks.text: By the end of this chapter, students will be able to:

items: Learn how to form hypotheses and perform hypothesis testing.
Learn how to communicate findings using advanced data visuals and tie them back to hypotheses.

blocks.text: In this chapter, students will learn the concept of hypothesis testing and its role in data analysis. They will understand what a hypothesis is and how research questions are converted into testable hypotheses. The chapter introduces different types of hypotheses, including the null hypothesis (H₀), and explains how to formulate correct hypotheses. Students will explore key concepts such as test statistics, critical regions, and p-values, and learn their importance in decision-making. They will follow the step-by-step process of hypothesis testing through simple numerical examples. The chapter also highlights the role of data visualization in presenting and linking results with hypotheses. In addition, students will learn about ethical issues such as bias and responsible use of data. By the end of this chapter, students will be able to interpret results and communicate conclusions clearly.
